placedBecause: an artifact written by a run outside the test process

witness.recorder: sweep() in scripts/reckoning/reckoning.py: a recursive walk of the run directory taken before and after the reckon build and stored in run.json under effect. It computes a byte count and sha256 per file. When this case was written cmd_take stored only the names and the count, so the recorder was stronger than the record it left — DEF-205, closed by PRO-0106. The record now carries the digest of every file written, the before-and-after pair for any file rewritten between the sweeps, and any file the build stopped writing. The count of two is unchanged and so is this case's two-way control.

armedBy: Two-way control: the sweep runs on a directory that did not exist before the build, so an empty before-set and a two-file after-set are different readings of the same instrument. A take that wrote nothing would record count 0, and the refusal path (CASE-0441) writes no directory at all. Count corrected from four to two at verification; the two-way control is unaffected, because what it turns on is empty against non-empty.
